spans.s: Khanīnetra, a king, son of Viviṃśa and father of Suvarcas. § 778c (Saṃvartta-Maruttīya). King Viviṃśa had fifteen sons, all powerful archers, revering brahmans, etc.; the eldest brother Kh. oppressed them all, but having conquered the entire kingdom he could not retain it, as the people were not pleased with him; they dethroned him and installed his son Suvarcas as king, and then they rejoiced: XIV, 4, 70, 71.
